facts.claim: Practice claim 1 about focused repetition improves skill after 2 weeks.
facts.mechanism: Repetition 1 builds myelin so retrieval becomes faster and more automatic over time.
facts.commonError: Learners confuse mere exposure 1 with deliberate effortful practice.
facts.whyWrong: Passive review 1 skips the error-correction loop that actually rewires the skill.
